Tell me about Opbeat

source: Tom's own account

Opbeat was a developer tools SaaS startup providing application performance monitoring. Backed by the cofounders of Facebook and Instagram. Later acquired by Elastic.

I joined as Head of Marketing and built the brand, marketing strategy, team and channels from scratch.

Key achievements:

  • Defined the product proposition and developer narrative
  • Trebled traffic and sign-ups in 12 months

Direct answers

  • The founders had a good product and famous backers, and believed that if they built it, customers would come. They launched into silence.
  • Our customers were in the US, so most of the marketing was international.
  • B2B devops startup backed by Balderton Capital and the cofounders of Facebook & Instagram.
  • Introduced KPIs, reporting & budgeting. Grew grassroots meetups and created video engine to connect with developers, creating the traction that enabled a $2M bridge-funding round.
  • Opbeat: restructured pricing, emphasised the free tier and removed the upgrade barriers that were killing conversions, alongside the growth engine that trebled sign-ups[OPBEAT.R1.GROWTH].

How did you grow Opbeat?

source: Tom's own account

Used data-driven marketing principles to treble traffic and sign-ups in 12 months. Blended experimentation, growth hacks and activation tactics.

The key here was understanding the developer audience - which I did by talking to the engineers in the team. This approach built loyalty that converted to sign-ups, and the brand became well known in the Python, Django and Node.js communities.
